subject: health
concept: Building a personal approach to balanced eating that fits real life, without rigid restriction
source_inspiration: original content, deliberately framed to avoid restrictive or numeric diet messaging — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a realistic week of varied, balanced meals reflecting their own preferences
exercise.abstract: Student explains how their eating approach balances variety, enjoyment, and health without rigid restriction

assessment.mastery_threshold: plan reflects genuine variety and balance, with no food group or food excluded entirely
misconception_flags: plan excludes an entire food group or reflects overly restrictive eating patterns

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
